## Checklist (per CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] `make all` green (lint + vet + race-tested tests + build)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]` — or change is typo/whitespace-exempt
- [ ] New ADR under `docs/decisions/` if this picks between genuine alternatives
- [ ] Docs updated in the same commit as behavior — no follow-up "fixup docs" PR
- [ ] Regression / property test included for any bug fix
- [ ] Risk-parameter change? New ADR + `docs/RISK.md` update + property test + 24h cooling-off (RISK.md §Risk-change procedure)
